data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'enkrateia', meaning 'strength, self-control, self-mastery'. In ancient Greece, encratites were ascetics who sought to live a life of purity and self-control. The name Encratis can be given to a child as a reminder to strive for spiritual growth and self-mastery. The name Encratis carries the meaning “Strong box, container” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Encratis usually hope their child will grow to embody strong box, container and live with faith, good character and purpose.
